title: CppCon 2016: Nicholas Ormrod “The strange details of std::string at Facebook"
summary: Nicholas Ormrod's CppCon 2016 talk on how Facebook optimizes std::string with its open-source replacement fbstring. It covers storage layout tradeoffs, small string optimization and memory allocation behavior.
why: HN returns to it as the go-to talk on string internals, small string packing and why small percentage optimizations matter at scale.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: it's still definitely worth a watch
